testName: Easy Spaces: Venue Space Reservation & Double-Booking Lockout
steps:
1. Open Easy Spaces App from App Launcher
2. Navigate to "Space Explorer" tab
3. Select Market "San Francisco Financial District"
4. Select Space "The Panorama Loft" (Max Capacity: 200)
5. Click "Book Reservation" button
6. Enter Reservation Dates: Next Friday 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM
7. Enter Expected Attendees "150"
8. Click "Confirm Reservation" button
9. In a separate browser tab, attempt to book "The Panorama Loft" for the same Friday time slot
10. Verify validation error banner: "Selected space is already reserved during this time period
